summary: Iteration 3 (IberoAcademy): tested the two new features — inline Office viewer for .pptx/.docx/.xlsx materials and grade-notification email after staff grades an open-question submission. Backend: 8/8 new pytest tests pass (test_iteration3.py). Covered: GET /api/files/{id}/viewer-url returns {url: https://<host>/api/public/files/<token>/file.<ext>} with proper scheme/path; requires access-token auth (401 without); 404 for non-Office files (pdf); invalid file token -> 403; file token cannot be used as access bearer (401 on /auth/me); access token presented in public-file path -> 403 (type check works both ways). Public /api/public/files/<token>/file.pptx returns raw bytes with no auth. Grade endpoint still returns graded submission (status=calificada, nota, score, passed) for an en_revision open-question submission and triggers background notify_grade without producing 'Grade email failed' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. Frontend: navigated as admin to /modulo/<id> with a .pptx material; iframe[data-testid='material-office-viewer-<id>'] renders with src = https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/embed.aspx?src=<url-encoded public URL>. Download link also present. (Office rendering shows 'can't open' because the uploaded test bytes are a fake pptx — expected; src and routing are correct.) PDF/image inline preview and download link still work (regression preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: notify_grade swallows exceptions by logging; a bad email (e.g., invalid HTML passing _assert_safe_email) would silently fail — consider also exposing a send-status flag on the submission for admins.

file_viewer_url uses x-forwarded-host/host header without validation; if a request is proxied with a spoofed Host header, the generated URL would point there. Low risk because the token still gates access, but consider pinning to a configured public BASE_URL env var.

create_file_token uses the same JWT_SECRET and HS256 as access tokens, distinguished only by 'type' claim. OK and correctly enforced in both directions, but a dedicated secret or asymmetric key for file tokens would reduce blast radius if the file token leaks are longer-lived in practice.
OFFICE_EXT literal lives in server.py while frontend has OFFICE_RE in Materials.jsx — kept in sync manually; consider deriving a single list on the backend and exposing /api/config to the frontend.

GET /api/public/files/{token}/{name} ignores the {name} segment entirely; a mismatched extension in the URL would still succeed. Minor cosmetic — Office viewer uses the ext for mime hinting, so keep as-is but worth a comment.
